description: Because of the documented trafficking routes in TRF-001, young women travelling alone are questioned about their purpose, sponsor, destination and relationship to whoever paid. The screening exists for good reason and is experienced as an accusation.
energy_note: Protected, in a way that feels exactly like suspicion.

aspect: The genuine traveller has no way to distinguish herself
description: A student with a scholarship and a trafficked woman with a coached story present similarly at a desk. The officer has minutes. The error runs in both directions and both errors are serious.
energy_note: An impossible judgement, made in ninety seconds.

aspect: Which creates the opening for extortion
description: A discretionary hold that can be released is a hold that can be sold. Informal payments at departure are widely reported and rarely recorded.
energy_note: A fee to be allowed onto a flight you paid for.

description: Twenty-four, funded place in Leeds, September start. At the desk she is asked who is paying, why a woman her age is travelling alone, and whether her family approve. She has the letter, the bank statement and the visa. She answers for forty minutes and makes the flight by eleven.
energy_note: Forty minutes of proving she is not being sold.
